description: The TYNDP scenarios are the joint electricity, gas and hydrogen scenarios that the European transmission system operator associations ENTSO-E and ENTSOG build every two years for their Ten-Year Network Development Plans, with pathways towards carbon neutrality in 2050. The site holds cycles from 2018 to 2026; the TYNDP 2026 package (draft report of June 2026) includes the scenarios report, methodology report and data tables, and model inputs for demand, electric vehicles, fuel and CO2 prices, heat, hydro inflows, hydrogen, line data, nodes, the Pan-European Climatic Database (PECD), the Pan-European Market Modelling Database (PEMMDB) and behind-the-meter capacities, plus hourly and KPI dashboards for its scenarios. The 2024 package adds the electricity and hydrogen reference grid and investment candidates, and a Zenodo mirror holds its line and node files. Coverage is Europe. Files are Excel, CSV and PDF, downloadable at no cost; the data are released under CC BY 4.0 with the attribution "TYNDP Scenarios". Caveats: scenarios are TSO planning assumptions that change between cycles, and some large series such as hourly demand are available on request. Simulation uses are pan-European market, network and capacity expansion models, climate-year stress tests and hydrogen and gas network planning. Related records: model-open-tyndp reproduces TYNDP studies with open tools.
